name: Mever
note: Sleeve sponsor on Dynamo Makhachkala's 2026-27 home shirt (club kit launch, 2026-07-25). Dagestan mineral-water brand of АО «Воды Рычал-Су» (Sostav, 2018). Left unrated: the company's shareholder list is held by its registrar and is not public, so the ultimate owner could not be established. No court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding found (searched 2026-10-03).
